annotations.title: Search US backcountry and wilderness permits

description: Find US backcountry and wilderness permits by name, park, trail or area, for hikes, climbs, river trips and overnight trips in national parks, national forests and state parks. Use this when someone asks how to get a permit or which permit a trip needs. Returns up to 10 permits with their PermitSnag page and whether PermitSnag scans them for cancellation openings. It does not check dates; use check_availability for that, and get_permit_details for the rules of one permit.

query.description: A permit, trail, park or area name, like "Mount Whitney" or "Enchantments".

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code to narrow results, like CA.

name: search_permits

outputSchema.description: US backcountry and wilderness permits that match the search.

scanRoute.description: How PermitSnag reaches this permit for cancellation openings: direct, through a zone or starting area, through its entry points, or none.

scannable.description: True when PermitSnag scans this permit for cancellation openings. Whether an alert is on offer today is in get_permit_details.

state.description: The two-letter state filter, or null.

title: Search US backcountry and wilderness permits
